classification.difficultyReason: Convert paired intervals into inequalities describing distance from a common centre, preserving endpoint inclusion.

content.prompt: Describe the following using absolute values.

spec.sourceRegion: Right column, first number line under 54–57
spec.description: Intervals from -4 to -2 and 2 to 4, with four open endpoints and integer ticks from -4 to 4.
spec.answerVisibility: Supplied question figure; no answer expression.

answer.worked: The intervals are $-4<x<-2$ and $2<x<4$. Their points are more than $2$ but less than $4$ units from $0$, so $2<|x|<4$.

spec.sourceRegion: Right column, second number line under 54–57
spec.description: Intervals from -4 to -2 and 0 to 2, with four filled endpoints and integer ticks from -4 to 4.
spec.answerVisibility: Supplied question figure; no answer expression.

answer.worked: The intervals are $-4\le x\le-2$ and $0\le x\le2$. Their points are between $1$ and $3$ units from $-1$, inclusive, so $1\le |x+1|\le3$.

spec.sourceRegion: Right column, third number line under 54–57
spec.description: Intervals from -3 to -1 and 2 to 4; outer endpoints filled, inner endpoints open.
spec.answerVisibility: Supplied question figure; no answer expression.

inlines.text: ; exclude the inner endpoints and include the outer endpoints.

answer.worked: The intervals are $-3\le x<-1$ and $2<x\le4$. The common centre is $\frac12$. The inner endpoints are $\frac32$ units from the centre and are excluded; the outer endpoints are $\frac72$ units away and are included. Thus $\frac32<\left|x-\frac12\right|\le\frac72$.

spec.sourceRegion: Right column, fourth number line under 54–57
spec.description: Intervals from -4 to -2 and 2 to 4; outer endpoints open, inner endpoints filled.
spec.answerVisibility: Supplied question figure; no answer expression.

answer.worked: The intervals are $-4<x\le-2$ and $2\le x<4$. Their points are at least $2$ but less than $4$ units from $0$, so $2\le |x|<4$.
